The season, which was named "[[Juan Carlos de Lima]]",{{Cite web |url=https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Deportes/Se-sorteo-el-fixture-de-la-Liga-AUF-Uruguaya--Como-es-el-arranque-y-cuando-es-el-clasico--uc951337 |title=Se sorteó el fixture de la Liga AUF Uruguaya: ¿Cómo es el arranque y cuándo es el clásico? |trans-title=The Liga AUF Uruguaya's fixture was drawn: How is the kickoff like and when is the ''clásico''? |publisher=Montevideo Portal |language=es |date=28 January 2026 |access-date=29 January 2026}} began on 6 February 2026.{{cite web|url=https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Deportes/Confirmadas-las-fechas-de-la-temporada-2026-del-futbol-uruguayo-calendario-y-cambios-uc946581 |title=Confirmadas las fechas de la temporada 2026 del fútbol uruguayo: calendario y cambios |trans-title=The dates for the 2026 season of Uruguayan football are confirmed: schedule and changes |publisher=Montevideo Portal |language=es |date=15 December 2025 |access-date=15 December 2025}} [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] are the defending champions. ==Teams== Sixteen teams compete in the season: the top thirteen teams in the [[2025 Liga AUF Uruguaya#Relegation|relegation table]] of the 2025 season as well as three promoted teams from the [[2025 Uruguayan Segunda División season|2025 Segunda División]]. ===Team changes=== The three lowest placed teams in the relegation table of the 2025 season ([[Club Plaza Colonia de Deportes|Plaza Colonia]], [[Miramar Misiones]] and [[Club Atlético River Plate (Montevideo)|River Plate]]) were relegated to [[Uruguayan Segunda División|Segunda División]] for the 2026 season.{{cite web|url=https://www.elpais.com.uy/ovacion/futbol/finalizo-la-fase-regular-de-la-liga-auf-uruguaya-campeones-clasificados-a-copas-internacionales-y-descendidos |title=Finalizó la fase regular de la Liga AUF Uruguaya: campeones, clasificados a copas internacionales y descendidos |trans-title=The Liga AUF Uruguaya's regular phase ended: champions, international cup qualifiers, and relegated teams |publisher=[[El País (Uruguay)|El País]] |language=es |date=9 November 2025 |access-date=24 November 2025}} They were replaced by the Segunda División champions [[Albion F.C.|Albion]], the runners-up [[Central Español]], and the winners of the promotion play-offs [[Deportivo Maldonado]]. Albion returned to the top flight after four years, having participated for the last time in [[2022 Uruguayan Primera División season|2022]],{{cite web|last1=Benítez |first1=Pablo |url=https://www.elobservador.com.uy/futbol/albion-vuelve-primera-un-proyecto-institucional-solido-y-otro-deportivo-ambicioso-clasificar-la-copa-libertadores-2027-n6020662 |title=Albion vuelve a Primera con un proyecto institucional sólido y otro deportivo ambicioso: clasificar a la Copa Libertadores 2027 |trans-title=Albion returns to First Division with a solid institutional project and an ambitious sporting one: to qualify for the 2027 Copa Libertadores |publisher=[[El Observador (Uruguay)|El Observador]] |language=es |date=13 October 2025 |access-date=24 November 2025}} while Central Español returned after a 13-year absence,{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.uy/futbol/uruguay/nota/_/id/15870514/central-espanol-regreso-primera-division-tras-mas-de-una-decada |title=Central Español regresó a Primera División tras más de una década |trans-title=Central Español returned to the First Division after more than a decade |publisher=[[ESPN (Latin America)|ESPN]] |language=es |date=26 October 2025 |access-date=24 November 2025}} and Deportivo Maldonado returned after one season. On the other hand, Plaza Colonia were relegated after one season, Miramar Misiones returned to the second tier after two seasons, and River Plate ended a 21-year spell in the top flight.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.uy/futbol/uruguay/nota/_/id/15774970/cuantos-anos-consecutivos-llevaba-river-plate-en-primera-division |title=¿Cuántos años consecutivos llevaba River Plate en Primera división? |trans-title=How many consecutive years had River Plate been in first division? |publisher=[[ESPN (Latin America)|ESPN]] |language=es |date=5 October 2025 |access-date=24 November 2025}} ===Stadiums and locations=== {{location map+ |Uruguay |float=right |width=450 |caption=Locations of the 2026 season teams outside [[Montevideo]]. |places= {{location map~ |Uruguay |lat=-34.90 |long=-56.15 |label=
